shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat index.html && cat vite.config.ts && for p in /AGENTS.md /home/AGENTS.md /home/sandbox/AGENTS.md /home/sandbox/workspace/AGENTS.md; do if [ -f "$p" ]; then cat "$p"; fi; done'
/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules -g '*playwright*' -g '*puppeteer*' | head -20 && rg --files src && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc "npm run build && node -e \"for (const p of ['playwright','@playwright/test','puppeteer']) { try { console.log(p,import.meta.resolve(p)) } catch {} }\""
/bin/bash -lc 'ls /tmp && which chromium || which chromium-browser || which google-chrome || true'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git diff --stat && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/fonts.css | head -20 && head -c 1200 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css'
